resources.string: Experimental appearance, animations and the new posting form
New field layout, formatting inside the editor and redesigned actions. Requires the new interface. Applies the next time the form is opened.
Material 3-style controls and playback speed menu. Turn off to restore the previous appearance. Applies the next time the player is opened.
Enabling predictive Back will also enable the new Material 3 interface.
Predictive Back in the old interface
Predictive Back may not work correctly in the old interface. Animation and navigation issues are possible. Enable it at your own risk.
Predictive Back will also be disabled. The regular Back swipe will continue to work.
